findings: canon-facts.json (54 facts) lives ONLY in corpus/60-lore/data/. NOTHING in game/ reads it. Its only consumers are two critic scripts: corpus/80-methods/canon-check.py and book-stats.py. This is the exact RI-MTH07 consumption failure: 'a registry nothing reads is a document'.

opacity.json (game/data/world/) BY CONTRAST is genuinely consumed: game/src/world/opacity.js OpacityRegister, engine.js throws on dangling anchor at boot, character/converse.js returns registered refusals. That is the model to copy.

W1-19-r1 verdict already prescribed: registry entries for Ixtu-Meer/Drowned Tally/Ninth Recension/Steward of the Count + a provenance block in game/data/quests/mainline.json naming registry ids per act.
SHIPPED LIBRARY IS NOW 111 BOOKS / 79,675 words / 49 contradiction edges across 20 files (the martial library landed). Brief said 70 books + 42 in flight; both are on disk.

27 OF THE 49 CONTRADICTION EDGES CARRY NO `cf`. RI-LOR06 s1 is unambiguous: 'Every contradiction in shipped content must be either (a) registered as disputed ... or (b) a bug. There is no third category.' orchestration/status/W1-LIBRARY-MARTIAL.json records the martial builder deciding edges 'DO NOT NEED A REGISTRY FACT ... legal by the checker'. The checker is not the rule; this is RI-LOR06 'How we lose' #3 (the registry goes stale) happening in writing.

RI-LOR06 Comparison Method 4 sets the bar at '>=8 fully-voiced disputes' and the registry contains SIX disputed facts. The bar is UNREACHABLE BY ARITHMETIC on the current registry: max score 3 of 5 no matter how good the build. Registering the genuine unregistered edges is the only route past it.
Only 11 distinct CF ids are cited anywhere in the shipped tree (CF-042,060,062,C001,C005,C007,D001,D003,D004,D005,D006). The other 43 registry facts have zero shipped citations.
game/data/books/manifest.json DOES NOT EXIST, yet RI-LOR06 Comparison Method 1 runs canon-check.py --books-manifest game/data/books/manifest.json. Phantom path in a gate.
deep-time.json exists: 8 books, 4,969 words (the Stone Nests trilogy, the tally-stones survey, the Oliis bargain, a Ninth Cohort survey fragment, and the two House-Under-the-Wastes readings).

BEFORE (measured by the new census on the untouched build): 0 of 6 disputes fully voiced; 39 of 49 contradiction edges malformed; 27 with no cf at all; 12 citing a registry fact that is not marked disputed (CF-042/060/062/C001/C005/C007 are plain facts with no positions).
AFTER: 20 of 20 disputes fully voiced (bar >=8), 49 of 49 edges registered, 0 unregistered. 10 of the 49 are RULED NOT DISPUTES.

THE RULING that does the work: a contradiction is a disagreement about what IS THE CASE; a disagreement about what is WORTH DOING is an argument and does not belong in the registry. Four martial edges are arguments (shield worth carrying / high grip worth the reach / hooked weapon fit for a soldier / shield line in standing water, which is a regulation against a practice).

ONE EDGE IS MIS-DECLARED: the-sap-and-the-knife <-> what-the-hollow-has-to-trade are ON THE SAME SIDE. Both argue the terms are depth-and-season and that 'whether' is not in them. The real opponent is the keepers, who had no book. Registered as CF-D017 with both texts under position A.

READING THE BOOKS REVERSED SEVERAL FIRST-PASS ATTRIBUTIONS, and this is the argument for reading them. The Blessings of the Coast AGREES the Legion does not go inland ('This is true, and we say so proudly') - so the dispute is not WHETHER but WHY, which is where the politics live. Prefect Arn's lease book is the DEFENCE, not the critique; the Casebook is the one that notices the consent question. On the Ninth Clause both dialogue voices treat the clause as existing, so both are position A.

FACTION IDS ARE SPELLED TWO WAYS ON NPC RECORDS: drowned-court 17 / the_drowned_court 11, wet-ledger 23 / the_wet_ledger 6, rootkeepers 22 / the_rootkeepers 4, ninth-cohort 44 / ninth_cohort 1, house_dres 1 / house-dres 1. Any matcher comparing exactly sees a fraction of the population and sees it silently. game/src/world/canon.js#fold() normalises; other pieces should check whether they do.

CONSUMPTION DEMONSTRATED (tools/lore/canon-consumption.mjs, PASS): 141 references resolve; a voiced_by naming a book nobody wrote goes red; a position with no holders goes red; 4 topics on which two REAL shipped people give incompatible registered answers (the-thinning 3 sides, the-weeping-ford, slavery, the-count-itself); 11/11 registered lines VANISH when the speaker is struck out of the register; 409 untagged answers byte-identical with and without it (the control); 336/336 people hold at least one registered position.

MY OWN PERTURBATION WAS WRONG FIRST TIME and its output told me: removing the actor alone left 4 of 11 lines standing because the speaker also matched by faction. A perturbation that leaves a second route open measures the route it forgot.
The shipped register carries NO ruling: 0 facts with authorially_true, 19 sha256 seals, 1 deliberately-open dispute unsealed. The game cannot adjudicate because the answer is not in the binary.

DEEP TIME, MEASURED: 21 distinct years are named across all shipped books and dialogue and ZERO are outside the Third Era. The dated history runs 3E 344 to 3E 425 - 81 years, all in living memory. 'four hundred' appears 121 times as a span phrase and 'four thousand' 18: the world gestures at depth constantly and dates nothing. The registry knew better (8 pre-3E facts) and none had a date field or a dispute attached. Now 12 facts carry a `when` spine (4 of them honestly `year: null` - the Duskfall is undated IN WORLD) and 5 of the 21 disputes are about the pre-Duskfall horizon.

NO ARGONIAN TRIBES IN THIS BUILD. Agacephs, Paatru, Archein, Sarpa, Dead-Water, Miredancers: all ZERO. Kothringi 22 and Lilmothiit 4 (both extinct in-world). 'Naga' 388 is a playable race here, not a tribe. The province runs on four constructed bodies instead: Deep-Kin 87, Xul-Aneekh 84, Drowned Court 64, Sap-Cutters 53, Wet Ledger 45. Registered as CF-C023 so the omission is a decision on the record.

THE SLAVE TRADE IS PRESENT MOSTLY AS THE EMPIRE'S EUPHEMISM FOR IT: lease/Blackrose 2,240 hits, House Dres 245, slave/slavery 42, soul-gem/soul-trade 15 - about fifty to one. CF-062 is hard canon that Dres has raided for centuries. A world that only says 'lease' has taken the Provincial Office's vocabulary as NARRATION, which RI-LOR06 s1.2 forbids at the authorial level. Registered as CF-C024, and CF-D008 now makes the euphemism somebody's POSITION rather than the world's voice.

THE REGISTRY WENT STALE DURING THIS RUN: CF-D021 was registered about four minutes after its two books landed from a piece still writing, and the census flipped PASS->FAIL->PASS inside one session. tools/lore/canon-census.mjs exits non-zero and should run where check-content.mjs runs. NOT wired in here on purpose - a hard gate landed mid-wave would fail another builder's in-flight book.
IN-PAGE VERIFICATION taken under contention (24 headless_shell, loadavg 21.07). Every figure from it is a count or a boolean, which survive contention; no timing figure was taken.
notes_for_successor:
The four things left, in order of value:
(1) WIRE tools/lore/canon-census.mjs INTO check-content.mjs once the wave's library work has landed. Without a gate the registry falls behind the shipped tree within MINUTES - it did so during this run.
(2) Ten stale cross-references remain: ten `contradicts[].cf` fields in books name a registry FACT rather than the DISPUTE that now registers them (CF-042->CF-D007, CF-062->CF-D008, CF-060/C001->CF-D010, CF-C007->CF-D009). Registration is by coverage so these are warnings, not failures. Not fixed because those files were being written by another agent throughout.
(3) game/data/books/manifest.json DOES NOT EXIST and RI-LOR06 comparison method 1 invokes canon-check.py --books-manifest against it. Phantom path inside a gate.
(4) Faction ids are spelled two ways on NPC records (drowned-court/the_drowned_court etc). world/canon.js#fold() normalises; other pieces matching on faction exactly are seeing a fraction of the population silently.
DO NOT register more disputes for volume. 21 is comfortably past RI-LOR06's bar of 8 and its 'How we lose' #8 is about a registry full of things a player cannot perceive. The next registration should come from a book pair that actually landed, the way CF-D021 did.
